capstones.name: Fellstrike Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, +55% accuracy, +35% damage, attacks ignore 25% of target's mitigation.
capstones.description: The fell strike — precision that pierces even dragon scale.

capstones.name: Sanctified Blessing (Rank II)
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, 50% chance for each heal to grant a 2000-point rune + cure one effect.
capstones.description: Sanctification perfected in the torment of Velious.

capstones.name: Explosion of Hatred
capstones.effect: AoE: 2500 + (level × 15) hate + damage to all enemies within 30 feet. Heal for 25% of total damage.
capstones.description: Hatred explodes outward — all shall know torment.

capstones.name: Stunning Kick (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Kick for 2000 + (level × 12) damage. Stun 8 seconds (even stun-immune take 4 sec). Interrupt.
capstones.description: The stunning kick perfected — even dragons stagger.

capstones.name: Escape (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Instant: drop all hate, become invisible + invulnerable for 10 seconds. Next backstab +100% damage.
capstones.description: The perfect escape — gone before the snow settles.

capstones.name: Decapitation (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Passive: 8% chance on hit to instantly kill humanoid targets below 30% HP. Active: next 3 hits +80% damage.
capstones.description: Decapitation — the axe remembers every neck.

capstones.name: Scout's Efficiency
capstones.effect: Group buff (10 min): -30% mana/endurance costs, +20% damage, +50% track range.
capstones.description: The scout's efficiency — nothing wasted in the torment.

capstones.name: Group Bestial Alignment
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, entire group gains +25% melee damage, +15% attack speed. Beastlord/warder gain double.
capstones.description: The pack aligns — beast, master, and allies as one.

capstones.name: Bladed Song
capstones.effect: Aura (3 min): allies' melee attacks deal +30% damage as magic. Enemies take 300/tick magic damage.
capstones.description: The bladed song — every strike sings with magic.

capstones.name: Celestial Cleansing (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Instantly cure all effects on the raid (not just group). Heal 500 per effect removed. Cannot be interrupted.
capstones.description: Celestial light scours the entire raid clean.

capstones.name: Nature's Guardian (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Self buff (5 min): 1500-point thorn shield (attackers take damage), +30% mitigation, +25% spell damage.
capstones.description: Nature itself stands guard — the torment cannot pass.

capstones.name: Cannibalization (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Convert 20% HP to 40% mana instantly. For 2 minutes, canni costs -50% HP.
capstones.description: The canni-dance perfected — blood to power, efficient as ice.

capstones.name: Clarity (Rank II)
capstones.effect: Group buff (10 min): +50 mana/tick, +25% spell damage, +20 to mental resists.
capstones.description: Perfect clarity — "crack" for the torment era.

capstones.name: Elemental Union (Rank II)
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, magician and pet both gain +45% damage, pet takes -35% damage, share 25% of damage taken.
capstones.description: Union perfected — two bodies, one will, unbreakable.

capstones.name: Arch Lich
capstones.effect: Lich form upgrade (permanent until cancelled): convert 20% of HP/tick to mana, +35% DoT damage, +15% lifetap effectiveness.
capstones.description: The arch lich — death transcended, power eternal.

capstones.name: Ethereal Incineration
capstones.effect: Nuke: 5000 + (level × 25) fire damage, unresistable. If target below 20% HP, double damage.
capstones.description: Ethereal fire — the wizard's answer to torment.
